div.div: This module is always clocked so that iDMA is able to react to incoming requests and to enable the datapath when needed.
The clk_i signal is coming from the top cluster level through another clock gating cell. This cell is controlled by the cluster control unit, so that the iDMA clock can be enabled/disabled via sw.

div.div: This portion of iDMA (including midend, backend, etc....) is clocked through a hw-controlled clock gating cell. The control logic for this cell makes sure that the iDMA dapath gets clocked only when needed (a transfer needs to be executed).
IMPORTANT: the global iDMA clock needs to be enabled via software through the cluster control unit.
